# Parameter reference

Every parameter of the expert mode with its unit, default, hard range and help text. The registry in
`suncore/core/params.py` is the single source of the expert page, the validation of `PUT
/api/v1/params` and this page.

- **Safety**: the range is the hard bound of the safety layer. A change needs a confirmation
  (`confirm_safety`), and no value inside the range switches a check off. Values outside the range
  are always rejected.
- **Restart**: takes effect only after a restart of the app. Parameters without this mark apply at
  once (the control stack hands over like after a device edit; the planner uses the new values from
  its next run).
- **What-if**: can be varied in what-if runs and backtests.
- Expert mode writes configuration only, never device set-points or modes.
- A value equal to the default is not stored; *Reset* removes the override.

## Controller and safety

| Key | Type | Unit | Default | Range | Marks | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `controller.balance_tolerance_pct` | float | % | 20 | 5 – 50 | Safety | **Balance tolerance in percent.** Relative part of the balance tolerance. A wider tolerance accepts worse data, so it is capped. Stored in the `expert` section. |
| `controller.balance_tolerance_w` | float | W | 500 | 100 – 2000 | Safety | **Balance tolerance.** The measured house load may deviate this much from PV plus grid minus battery before the data counts as inconsistent. A wider tolerance accepts worse data, so it is capped. Stored in the `expert` section. |
| `controller.default_hysteresis_delay_s` | float | s | 60 | 0 – 3600 | – | **Default hysteresis delay.** How long a condition must hold before a device switches, used for devices that do not set their own. Stored in the `expert` section. |
| `controller.default_hysteresis_w` | float | W | 100 | 0 – 5000 | – | **Default hysteresis power.** Power band between switching a device on and off, used for devices that do not set their own. A wider band switches less often. Stored in the `expert` section. |
| `controller.default_max_switches_per_hour` | int | 1/h | 6 | 1 – 30 | Safety | **Default maximum switches per hour.** Upper limit of switching operations per device and hour, used for devices that do not set their own. Protects relays and compressors; capped by the safety layer. Stored in the `expert` section. |
| `controller.default_settle_s` | float | s | 10 | 1 – 600 | Safety | **Default settle time.** Wait after a switch before the result is read back, used for devices that do not set their own. Too short a time reads the device before it has reacted. Stored in the `expert` section. |
| `controller.deficit_budget_wh` | float | Wh | 50 | 0 – 500 | Safety | **Deficit battery budget.** Battery energy a single deficit may draw before the controller backs off. Capped by the safety layer. Stored in the `expert` section. |
| `controller.deficit_delay_s` | float | s | 30 | 5 – 120 | Safety | **Deficit delay.** How long controlled devices may cause grid import or battery discharge before the controller backs off. A longer delay lets the deficit last longer, so it is capped. Stored in the `expert` section. |
| `controller.frozen_pv_min_w` | float | W | 200 | 50 – 1000 | Safety | **Frozen PV minimum power.** Below this PV power the frozen-value check does not apply (night, snow). Stored in the `expert` section. |
| `controller.frozen_pv_s` | float | s | 900 | 60 – 3600 | Safety | **Frozen PV detection time.** PV power that stays unchanged for this long in daylight counts as an inverter hang. A longer time detects it later. Stored in the `expert` section. |
| `controller.inputs_max_age_ticks` | int | ticks | 3 | 1 – 10 | Safety | **Maximum age of site data.** Flows and surplus older than this many control intervals count as unknown, and the safety layer then refuses every load increase. Stored in the `expert` section. |
| `controller.intent_max_age_s` | float | s | 30 | 1 – 120 | Safety | **Maximum age of a command.** A command that is older than this when it reaches the safety layer is dropped as stale. A longer limit lets outdated decisions through, so it is capped. Stored in the `expert` section. |
| `controller.max_jump_w_per_s` | float | W/s | 20000 | 1000 – 50000 | Safety | **Plausible power change.** Site power that changes faster than this is treated as a unit or sensor fault. A larger value accepts implausible readings, so it is capped. Stored in the `expert` section. |
| `controller.min_write_interval_s` | float | s | 5 | 1 – 600 | Safety | **Minimum write interval.** Shortest time between two writes to the same device. Protects devices and Home Assistant from rapid writes; it cannot go below the hard limit. Stored in the `expert` section. |
| `controller.proposal_ttl_s` | float | s | 120 | 10 – 3600 | – | **Proposal lifetime.** In assisted mode a proposal expires after this time if you do not confirm it. Stored in the `expert` section. |
| `controller.release_deadline_s` | float | s | 10 | 1 – 60 | Safety | **Release deadline.** On shutdown or a configuration change, all devices must be handed back within this time. Stored in the `expert` section. |
| `controller.reserve_w` | float | W | 100 | 50 – 10000 | Safety | **Surplus reserve.** Power that is never handed to devices, as a margin for measurement noise and small loads. A smaller reserve gets closer to the import limit, so it cannot go below the hard limit. Stored in the `expert` section. |
| `controller.safe_state_cooldown_s` | float | s | 120 | 30 – 3600 | Safety | **Safe-state cooldown.** After a fault has cleared, control only resumes once the fault has stayed away for this long. A shorter time resumes control sooner, so it cannot go below the hard limit. Stored in the `expert` section. |
| `controller.smoothing_s` | float | s | 60 | 0 – 900 | – | **Surplus smoothing.** Time window over which the measured surplus is averaged before devices are switched. Longer smoothing avoids switching on short clouds. Stored in the `expert` section. |
| `controller.stale_cadence_factor` | float | x | 2 | 1 – 5 | Safety | **Staleness factor.** A slow sensor counts as stale after its usual update interval times this factor without a change. A larger factor tolerates older data, so it is capped. Stored in the `expert` section. |
| `controller.tick_s` | float | s | 5 | 2 – 60 | – | **Control interval.** How often the controller looks at the surplus and decides. Shorter reacts faster but writes more often; every device write is still limited by the write interval. Stored in the `expert` section. |

## Planner and solver

| Key | Type | Unit | Default | Range | Marks | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `planner.budget_s` | float | s | 8 | 0.5 – 120 | What-if | **Solver time budget.** Time one planner run may take. When the solver misses it, the simple heuristic plan covers the gap. Applies from the next run. Stored in the `expert` section. |
| `planner.min_event_gap_s` | float | s | 60 | 10 – 3600 | – | **Minimum gap between triggered runs.** At most one planner run is started by an event (price, forecast or configuration change) in this time. Stored in the `expert` section. |
| `planner.mip_gap` | float | ratio | 0.01 | 0 – 0.5 | What-if | **Solver optimality gap.** Relative distance to the optimum at which the solver stops. Smaller is more exact and slower. Stored in the `expert` section. |
| `planner.net_deviation_s` | float | s | 1800 | 300 – 7200 | – | **Duration of the net power deviation.** How long the net power deviation must last before a new plan is requested. Stored in the `expert` section. |
| `planner.net_deviation_w` | float | W | 1500 | 100 – 10000 | – | **Net power deviation for a new plan.** A new plan is requested when PV minus load stays this far from the forecast for the deviation time. Stored in the `expert` section. |
| `planner.soc_deviation_pct` | float | % | 10 | 1 – 50 | – | **SoC deviation for a new plan.** A new plan is requested when the battery charge differs this much from the plan. Stored in the `expert` section. |
| `planner.stale_after_s` | float | s | 7200 | 900 – 86400 | – | **Plan staleness.** A plan older than this is flagged as stale and is no longer handed to the controller, which then falls back to its default behaviour. Stored in the `expert` section. |

## Tariff

| Key | Type | Unit | Default | Range | Marks | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tariff.export.negative_reference_entity` | entity | – | unset | – | – | **Spot price sensor for the negative-price rule.** Optional sensor with the spot price per kWh. With an all-in tariff such as Tibber the spot price is unknown, so the rule judges the import end price. With this sensor it judges the real spot price for the current slot; later slots keep using the end price. Empty keeps the end price. Stored in the `tariff` section at `export.negative_reference_entity`. |
| `tariff.export.remunerate_negative` | bool | – | off | – | – | **Remunerated at negative prices.** Turn this on when your plant is paid for feed-in even in hours with a negative spot price (for example older plants not affected by section 51 EEG). Then the region's no-remuneration rule is not applied to your export price. Off keeps the region's rule. Stored in the `tariff` section at `export.remunerate_negative`. |

## Forecast

| Key | Type | Unit | Default | Range | Marks | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `forecast.learning.load_ml_mode` | enum | – | shadow | `off` / `shadow` / `auto` | – | **Machine-learning load model.** Off: not used. Shadow: runs in parallel and is only scored and shown. Auto: used when it beats the profile forecast in the accuracy statistics. Stored in the `forecast` section at `learning.load_ml_mode`. |
| `forecast.learning.min_history_days` | int | d | 30 | 1 – 365 | – | **Days of history before learning.** Before this many days of history exist, calibration and the machine-learning load model only collect statistics and change nothing. Stored in the `forecast` section at `learning.min_history_days`. |
